taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: Concurrency and atomic business invariants — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Identify the shared invariant, read/check/commit locations, transaction isolation, lock/idempotency scope and retry behavior. Use a bounded local fixture for state-changing concurrency.
controls.controlled_verification: Instrument the real operation with barriers to interleave two requests at the suspected check/use window. Compare serial execution and the controlled interleaving, observing the durable invariant rather than successful response counts. Record the schedule and final ledger/state.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Two 200 responses can correspond to one idempotent commit. A race in a simplified model is not proof the production transaction permits that schedule; retain that limitation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Make the invariant atomic using the platform's supported transaction/constraint/idempotency mechanism. Repeat the original schedule, serial legitimate use and retry/rollback control.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
